name: presidio-ts
description: Presidio PII detection and anonymization - TypeScript port

scripts.lint: biome check packages scripts fixtures/mv3 package.json package-lock.json biome.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.browser.json tsconfig.node.json vitest.config.ts README.md plan.md docs/capability-parity-matrix.md
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write packages scripts fixtures/mv3 package.json package-lock.json biome.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.browser.json tsconfig.node.json vitest.config.ts README.md plan.md docs/capability-parity-matrix.md
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.test:mv3: npm run build -w presidio-mv3-fixture && test -f fixtures/mv3/dist/manifest.json && test -f fixtures/mv3/dist/service-worker.js && ! rg -n 'node:|require\(|process\.|Buffer|child_process' fixtures/mv3/dist
scripts.release:check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run pack:check && npm run test:mv3
